report.answer: Shell-dependent on this worktree: cmd-shim-presence (PowerShell finds .cmd, both bash-likes miss it), msys-sdcard-intact (only Git Bash/MSYS rewrites /sdcard), crlf-agent-sh (GNU/WSL bash -n rejects CRLF if/then; Git Bash igncr accepts it), ps-caret-git-ref (PowerShell git.cmd caret unescape drops trailing ^ and resolves HEAD not HEAD^). Portable subset: ['msys-data-nopathconv', 'portable-lf-printf', 'pytest-argv-portable']. Plugin launchers NOT-CHECKED (absent). Native pwsh/Git Bash/wsl.exe are absent; GNU bash is live; Windows columns are labeled executable models. SUCCESS:CNF-0150
